Manhattan Active SCALE Documentation
        Rate Shopping Web Service
    
    
         
                Collapse All
                Expand All
            
        View with Navigation Tools
    
    
    
    
    
        The Rate Shopping Web Service is used to invoke the Rate Shopping function of the application.  The carrierRateList resource represents the theoretical rate results for a Shipment Header.

For information on the configuration and use of Rate Shopping, please refer to the applications help.


     Request



    
        URI: http://ServerName/ILSIntegrationServices/Shipping/carrierRateList

        Method: POST

        Content-Type: application/xml

        Roles: SCALEUSER,Confidential

        
            Entity:

            
                
                    CarrierRateListCriteria.xsd: Contains real or virtual information for a single Shipment Header used to calculate the CarrierRateList.

                    
                        Address.xsd: Used to express one of the addresses to validate.
                    
                
            
        
    



     Response



    Aside from standard responses, note the following specifics for this service:

    

    
        
            
                Status Code

                Notes
            

            
                200

                
                    OK will be accompanied by an entity conforming to the following schema:

                    
                        CarrierRateList.xsd: Contains a list of rate information or errors.

The Rate Shopping Web Service is used to invoke the Rate Shopping function of the application.  The carrierRateList resource represents the theoretical rate results for a Shipment Header.



For information on the configuration and use of Rate Shopping, please refer to the applications help.




     Request





    

        
URI: http://ServerName/ILSIntegrationServices/Shipping/carrierRateList


        
Method: POST


        
Content-Type: application/xml


        
Roles: SCALEUSER,Confidential


        

            Entity:

            

                

                    CarrierRateListCriteria.xsd: Contains real or virtual information for a single Shipment Header used to calculate the CarrierRateList.

                    

                        
Address.xsd: Used to express one of the addresses to validate.

                    

                

            

        

    






     Response





    
Aside from standard responses, note the following specifics for this service:


    



    

        

            

                
Status Code


                
Notes

            


            

                
200


                

                    
OK will be accompanied by an entity conforming to the following schema:


                    

                        
CarrierRateList.xsd: Contains a list of rate information or errors.
